text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Now then, a toast to Christmas Eve, and 
to... 
Phalaeno's triumph in the Queen Elizabeth 
II Cup! 
Cheers!

It was Christmas Eve. Phalaenopsis and I 
were attending a Christmas party 
hosted by the club.

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Phalaeno! Eat and drink up! 
You're basically the star of the show 
today!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... 
Thank you, I gladly will.

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! We have a new girl who's 
aiming for the Tiara just like you... 
Hey! Come on over and introduce yourself!

text_block_list.name: New Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the wonderful 
advice. 
I'm not great with sudden temperature 
changes either... 
so I'll definitely give the training you 
suggested a try.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Anytime. If there's ever anything on your 
mind, 
don't hesitate to reach out.

text_block_list.name: New Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ma'am! I'd love to ask for your help 
again 
in the future. —Well, um...

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
"Phalaeno! Please try the stew I made!" 
"Um, can we exchange LANE IDs...?" 
"Phalaeno-chaaan, listen to my problems 
too~!"

text_block_list.name: New Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
...If I keep you all to myself, 
the upperclassmen are gonna be mad at me. 
Catch you later!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Heh... Until next time.

And so, the day after the party with 
everyone 
from the Club—Christmas Day arrived.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.
choice_data_list: That Christmas party was a lot of fun!
That Christmas party was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. ...Though it was a bit 
hectic, I must say.
choice_data_list:
You were in high demand with both your 
juniors and seniors, after all.

You were in high demand with both your 
juniors and seniors, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
They even gave me a souvenir from the 
Club. 
It is stylish incense, and when lit, a 
lovely sandalwood scent 
wafts through the air... Big-dono was 
quite fond of it as well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Receiving such gracious hospitality 
truly brought it home to me once more.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: We truly have seized victory, haven't we?

Her victory in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup 
breathed even more energy into the Club.

Phalaenopsis had splendidly achieved her 
goal of 
paving the way for the Club's future. 
Which was why—
choice_data_list:
(I'd like her to take it easy once in a 
while, but...)

text_block_list.text:
Going by our routine, training was 
scheduled for this 
afternoon. As I was pondering how to get 
her 
to take a break...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
I have a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I would like to take today off from 
training. 
Would that be acceptable?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...You are beaming from ear to ear. 
What, do you despise training with me so 
much?
choice_data_list: No way! That's not it at all—

text_block_list.text:
I was just so glad she asked for a break 
of her own 
accord that I ended up getting carried 
away.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Nor do I believe in taking rest 
lightly. 
It is precisely after achieving a great 
ambition that one 
must tighten the slackening belt once 
more.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
However... if I do not do this, you would 
not 
halt your stride, would you? —I speak of 
you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Yes, you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The lights in the Trainer's office were on 
until late the other night. 
Did you truly believe I would not notice?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to apologize. 
...I understand how you feel all too well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It seems we are cut from the same cloth. 
A junior at the Club pointed it out to me 
before— 
neither of us is particularly skilled at 
relaxing when idle.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: However, today is Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Would it not be worthwhile for us to 
strive toward it together?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Besides...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...No, that can wait in due time. 
For now, let us indulge in some leisurely 
amusement.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! 
How magnificent and colossal!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Such a dignified presence... It radiates 
true majesty. 
I would relish the chance to test my 
mettle against it someday—the whale shark.

We toured the aquarium, visited at 
Phalaenopsis's suggestion. 
Seeing her gaze happily at the tank, I 
asked:

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. In fact, whenever a moment of 
leisure presents itself, 
I sometimes take a solitary stroll here.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I am drawn to them. Sharks, whales, giant 
squids... 
The colossal behemoths that dominate the 
ocean depths.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I looked into it a bit, and marine 
creatures are apparently 
prone to gigantism. Freed from the bounds 
of gravity, 
such colossal bodies are capable of 
surviving, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
There are also theories that they grow 
large to retain heat... 
or that the deep sea fosters massive 
creatures 
in order to withstand the immense water 
pressure.
choice_data_list: ...? So which theory is actually right?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
There is no definitive consensus. But 
precisely because of that... 
do you not find it brimming with romance?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To absentmindedly gaze upon colossal 
beings filled with 
the unknown, scarcely ever seen upon the 
earth... 
That is what I love.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Look, Trainer, a ray. 
Fufu... What a charmingly goofy look it 
has.
choice_data_list:
You know, when I first wake up, I kind of 
look like that too...

You know, when I first wake up, I kind of 
look like that too...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Come again? ......

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Pfft! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Forgive me. 
I simply couldn't help picturing it...
choice_data_list:
Do you never look like that in the 
morning, Phalaeno?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Me? Never. 
I have always awakened quite refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
As for you... fufu. 
If you make such a face, are you not fond 
of mornings?
choice_data_list: Yeah, they really aren't my strong suit.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I see. Try washing your face with cold 
water, 
and basking thoroughly in the sunlight. Do 
so, and 
you are certain to look sharp and 
dignified.
choice_data_list:
...For the record, this is what I look 
like in the morning.

...For the record, this is what I look 
like in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! ...Enough. You need not reenact it 
right now. 
Kh-fufu... Are you trying to exhaust me 
with laughter?

And so, chatting about such silly, trivial 
things, 
I toured the aquarium with Phalaenopsis—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hm, that was quite delightful. For the two 
of us, 
I would say we succeeded in unwinding 
rather well, wouldn't you?

Nodding at her words, I took out the 
"thing I bought," 
and handed it right over to her.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is this parcel?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...! 
Whenever did you manage to get this?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: May I open it?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Why, this is... oh! 
What a thoroughly adorable ray plushie.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I shall treasure it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Indeed, there is a resemblance.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Truly... I am always on the 
receiving end with you.

If anything, I was the one constantly 
learning from Phalaenopsis— 
from watching my master's back. In the 
end, 
even the glorious legacy she carved on the 
turf was only because...
choice_data_list: Because you trained your disciple so well.
Because you trained your disciple so well.

text_block_list.text:
I only became someone capable of giving 
back to her 
because of Phalaenopsis. I would never 
forget that 
and let it get to my head.
choice_data_list: I'll keep following your lead, Master!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: The time has come, then.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
There is something I must tell you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Shall we move elsewhere? 
The roadside lacks the proper grace.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list:
(She has such a solemn look on her 
face...)

text_block_list.text:
For some reason, my heart stirred with 
unease... Perhaps, 
deep down, I already knew.
choice_data_list: (What is she about to say to me...?)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
You have truly grown beyond recognition.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The person who was consumed by fear, lost 
about the future, and 
turning away from their heavy 
responsibilities is no more.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You have become such an admirable Trainer 
that I almost 
feel guilty keeping you all to myself.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Therefore, hear my decree.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —You have attained full mastery.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
As of now, we are no longer master and 
disciple.

To me, that was the highest praise 
imaginable. 
For my master had acknowledged 
that I had fully matured as her disciple.

And yet... even so. 
Even knowing that full well...—
choice_data_list:
(I just wanted to keep supporting Master a 
little longer...)

text_block_list.text: That was what I found myself thinking.

Yet naturally, I did not give voice to 
such feelings. 
Quietly swallowing down that swirl of 
emotions— 
as her Trainer, I looked back into her 
eyes.

That was what I needed to do, having been 
granted 
full mastery by my teacher.
choice_data_list:
It's all thanks to you, Phalaeno. Thank 
you.

It's all because of you, Phalaeno. Thank 
you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: No, it is the fruit of your own endeavors.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You have lived up to my expectations. 
Far beyond measure. —And for that, I am 
proud.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You have my heartfelt gratitude. 
Thank you, for everything up until today.

Grateful as I was, there was still a 
question I had to ask. 
Now that our master-disciple bond had 
ended... 
what kind of relationship did Phalaenopsis 
want with me?

Would our Trainer contract remain in 
place? 
And if so... how long 
would I be permitted to support her?
choice_data_list: So, about where we go from here...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Trainer. 
Touching on that very matter...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —You are to remain by my side.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Did you not hear me? 
Then allow me to say it once more.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I need you in my future.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Because you were there, I could achieve 
such splendid results. 
Because you were there, the Club was able 
to grasp its future.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Yet, I am an ambitious soul. 
Accomplishing one feat is not the end. 
I hold a new ambition, and shall press 
forward toward it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To sustain me on my journey toward it— 
I shall still need you, from this day 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...You are no longer disciple, and I no 
longer master. 
The lessons I can impart to you 
will only dwindle with time.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet, even so... when our Club blooms 
into a wondrous garden. That very view—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I wish to behold it together with you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Understood?

...A surge of joy welled up from deep 
within my chest. 
I had assumed that if we were no longer 
master and disciple, 
my duty of supporting her had reached its 
end as well.

I nodded firmly at her words. Before I 
even 
realized it, a smile was breaking across 
my face.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: A fine response.
